description: 2026-11-11 benchmark delivery baseline; Apple M4 Pro only. Generation timings are Node, allocation estimates are bundled headless Chromium. No phone performance claim. Full local reports/profiles: data/scratch/generation-237/.

scope.generate: Fresh planner caches per fixture/trial; all unseen chunks then same-coordinate regeneration. JIT stays warm across fixtures. Phases are exclusive; terrain includes its internal regional planning. No persistence, live admission, autotiling, physics, traffic services, replication or rendering.
scope.streaming: Production RealmStreaming + procedural registries + RealmRecords, empty MemoryRecordStore, batches of up to eight unique chunks; all earlier batches stay resident. totalMs is awaited batch wall time, NOT a single Worker task or disk latency. publications records synchronous per-chunk publication. phasesMs partitions the batch into exclusive timings. Excludes physics, autotiling, traffic services, replication and rendering. Verification hashes terrain/rail metadata only; live props/actors are counted.
scope.observation: Counts/records are collected after timers, but can affect later GC. No forced GC or discarded warmup. Verify/profile runs are diagnostic, not timing baselines. FNV-1a content hashes are regression checks, not cryptographic identities.

allocations.scope: Main thread only, cadence sample and its setup/diagnostics; GPU finish window skipped. Includes benchmark bookkeeping and collected objects. Estimated allocations, not retained heap or a GC-cause diagnosis. Sampling affects timing; compare cadence in a separate uninstrumented run.
